Database Design

1. Overview

StudyLens AI uses SQLite to store question-and-answer history. The database table is named "qa_history".

2. Table Design

Table name: "qa_history"

Column| Data type| Description
"id"| INTEGER| Primary key that uniquely identifies each record
"created_at"| TEXT| Date and time when the record was created
"doc_name"| TEXT| Name of the PDF document
"question"| TEXT| Question asked by the user
"answer"| TEXT| Answer generated by the system
"pages"| TEXT| JSON list of cited page numbers
"top_score"| REAL| Best similarity score returned during retrieval

3. Why SQLite?

- SQLite does not require a separate database server.
- It can store question-and-answer history for later reference.
- Its SQL queries make it easy to retrieve and filter stored records.

4. FAISS Index

The FAISS vector index is held in memory and rebuilt for each PDF. It is used to search for relevant text chunks based on vector similarity.

5. Summary

SQLite stores the question-and-answer history, while FAISS supports similarity-based retrieval of relevant document passages.
